paragraphs: He reports Rabbi Pedat, who reports Rabbi Yochanan: Berakhot 55b.[^1]

notes.text: The supplied text has פרת. The stored William Davidson Edition of Berakhot 55b explicitly has Rav Huna bar Ami reporting Rabbi Pedat (פדת), who reports Rabbi Yochanan. Pedat is the inherited editorial reading in English; it is not the supplied letters. The exact scalar supports both Rabbi expansions and the chain, without proving printed letters or a correction history.
